{"tools":[
{"name":"create_card_payment","description":"Charges a card, either a saved payment method or a single-use token, for a given amount. Use it to take a new card payment, with the option to authorize now and capture later.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"amount":{"type":"integer","description":"Amount in minor units (e.g. cents)","minimum":1},"currency":{"type":"string","description":"ISO 4217 code, e.g. EUR"},"payment_method_id":{"type":"string","description":"Saved payment method ID or single-use card token"},"customer_id":{"type":"string"},"capture":{"type":"boolean","description":"False to authorize only; defaults to true"},"description":{"type":"string"},"statement_descriptor":{"type":"string","maxLength":22},"idempotency_key":{"type":"string"},"metadata":{"type":"object","additionalProperties":{"type":"string"}}},"required":["amount","currency","payment_method_id"]},"request":"Charge the card token tok_visa_8841 for 89.90 EUR and describe it as 'Order 10542 - winter jacket'."},
{"name":"get_payment","description":"Retrieves the full details of one card payment: status, amount, card brand and last four digits, risk score, 3-D Secure result, and amounts refunded or disputed. Use it to check what happened to a specific payment.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"payment_id":{"type":"string","description":"Payment ID, e.g. pay_..."}},"required":["payment_id"]},"request":"What's the 3-D Secure result and risk score on payment pay_3KfT92xQ?"},
{"name":"list_payments","description":"Searches card payments with filters for date range, status, amount, card brand, and customer. Use it to find payments when you don't have the payment ID.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"status":{"type":"string","enum":["pending","authorized","captured","failed","voided","partially_refunded","refunded"]},"created_from":{"type":"string","format":"date-time"},"created_to":{"type":"string","format":"date-time"},"min_amount":{"type":"integer"},"max_amount":{"type":"integer"},"card_brand":{"type":"string","enum":["visa","mastercard","amex","discover","jcb","unionpay"]},"customer_id":{"type":"string"},"limit":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":100,"default":25},"cursor":{"type":"string"}},"required":[]},"request":"Show me all failed Mastercard payments over 200 euros from last week."},
{"name":"capture_payment","description":"Captures a previously authorized card payment, in full or in part. Use it when the goods ship and the held funds should be collected.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"payment_id":{"type":"string"},"amount":{"type":"integer","description":"Amount to capture in minor units; defaults to the full authorized amount"},"final_capture":{"type":"boolean","description":"If true, releases any remaining authorized amount"}},"required":["payment_id"]},"request":"The parcel for authorization pay_9Lm2QaZ1 has shipped, so please capture the payment, but only 45.00 of the authorized amount."},
{"name":"void_payment","description":"Cancels an authorized but uncaptured card payment and releases the hold on the customer's card. Use it when an order is cancelled before capture. It cannot be used on captured payments, which need a refund.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"payment_id":{"type":"string"},"reason":{"type":"string","enum":["customer_request","out_of_stock","fraud_suspected","duplicate","other"]}},"required":["payment_id"]},"request":"Release the hold on authorization pay_5TqW08nD, because the item is out of stock and we aren't going to ship it."},
{"name":"create_payment_refund","description":"Refunds a captured card payment to the customer's original card, either fully or partially. Use it to return money on the payment itself, not for managing orders or returns in the shop system.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"payment_id":{"type":"string"},"amount":{"type":"integer","description":"Minor units; omit for a full refund"},"reason":{"type":"string","enum":["requested_by_customer","duplicate","fraudulent","other"]},"note":{"type":"string","description":"Internal note, not shown to the customer"},"idempotency_key":{"type":"string"}},"required":["payment_id"]},"request":"Refund 15.00 back to the card on payment pay_7HcR41vB because the customer got a damaged strap."},
{"name":"list_payment_refunds","description":"Lists card refunds with their status (pending, succeeded, failed) and expected arrival date, filterable by payment or date. Use it to check whether a refund went through.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"payment_id":{"type":"string"},"status":{"type":"string","enum":["pending","succeeded","failed","canceled"]},"created_from":{"type":"string","format":"date-time"},"created_to":{"type":"string","format":"date-time"},"limit":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":100,"default":25},"cursor":{"type":"string"}},"required":[]},"request":"Did the refund on payment pay_2WnB66kE actually succeed, or is it still pending at the bank?"},
{"name":"list_chargebacks","description":"Lists card chargebacks (disputes) filtered by status, reason code, or response deadline. Use it to see which disputes are open and which are close to their deadline.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"status":{"type":"string","enum":["needs_response","under_review","won","lost","accepted"]},"reason_code":{"type":"string","description":"Card network reason code, e.g. 4853 or 10.4"},"respond_by_before":{"type":"string","format":"date-time","description":"Only disputes whose response deadline falls before this time"},"created_from":{"type":"string","format":"date-time"},"created_to":{"type":"string","format":"date-time"},"limit":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":100,"default":25},"cursor":{"type":"string"}},"required":[]},"request":"Which chargebacks still need a response and are due within the next 5 days?"},
{"name":"get_chargeback","description":"Retrieves one chargeback with its reason code and description, disputed amount, network fee, deadline, and any evidence already submitted. Use it to understand a specific dispute before responding.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"chargeback_id":{"type":"string","description":"Chargeback ID, e.g. dp_..."}},"required":["chargeback_id"]},"request":"Pull up the details for chargeback dp_1Qx84Lr, since I want to know what reason the cardholder gave."},
{"name":"submit_chargeback_evidence","description":"Submits evidence to contest a chargeback, such as proof of delivery, customer communication, or the refund policy. Use it to respond before the deadline. A submission is final.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"chargeback_id":{"type":"string"},"product_description":{"type":"string"},"customer_communication":{"type":"string","description":"Text of relevant emails or chat messages"},"shipping_carrier":{"type":"string"},"shipping_tracking_number":{"type":"string"},"shipping_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"refund_policy_text":{"type":"string"},"uncategorized_text":{"type":"string"},"file_ids":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"IDs of uploaded evidence files"},"submit":{"type":"boolean","description":"True to finalize and send to the issuer; false to save as a draft","default":false}},"required":["chargeback_id"]},"request":"For dispute dp_8Zt30Pw, send in the DHL tracking number 00340434292135100186 with shipping date 12 May and submit it to the bank now."},
{"name":"accept_chargeback","description":"Accepts liability for a chargeback without contesting it, so the disputed amount and the dispute fee are kept by the cardholder's bank. Use it when the dispute is not worth fighting.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"chargeback_id":{"type":"string"},"note":{"type":"string"}},"required":["chargeback_id"]},"request":"We don't have any proof for dispute dp_4Bn19Ys, so just accept it and close it out."},
{"name":"list_payouts","description":"Lists payouts sent from the payment balance to the merchant's bank account, with amount, status, arrival date, and destination. Use it to see what money has been or will be deposited.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"status":{"type":"string","enum":["pending","in_transit","paid","failed","canceled"]},"arrival_from":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"arrival_to":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"destination_account_id":{"type":"string"},"limit":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":100,"default":25},"cursor":{"type":"string"}},"required":[]},"request":"List the payouts that are still in transit to our bank account."},
{"name":"get_payout","description":"Retrieves one payout with its gross amount, fees deducted, net amount, bank destination, statement descriptor, and failure reason if any. Use it to investigate a single deposit.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"payout_id":{"type":"string","description":"Payout ID, e.g. po_..."}},"required":["payout_id"]},"request":"Why did payout po_6Jd02Kc fail? Our bank says they never received it."},
{"name":"list_payout_transactions","description":"Lists the individual payments, refunds, chargebacks, and fees that make up a payout. Use it to reconcile a bank deposit against the underlying transactions.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"payout_id":{"type":"string"},"type":{"type":"string","enum":["payment","refund","chargeback","fee","adjustment"]},"limit":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":500,"default":100},"cursor":{"type":"string"}},"required":["payout_id"]},"request":"Break down payout po_8Vh55Re into the payments, refunds and fees it contains, so I can match it to our bank deposit of 4,212.37."},
{"name":"create_instant_payout","description":"Sends available balance to the merchant's debit card or bank account immediately, for an instant-payout fee, instead of waiting for the regular schedule. Use it when cash is needed today.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"amount":{"type":"integer","description":"Minor units; must not exceed the instant-available balance"},"currency":{"type":"string"},"destination_account_id":{"type":"string"},"statement_descriptor":{"type":"string","maxLength":22}},"required":["amount","currency","destination_account_id"]},"request":"Send 2,500 USD to our business debit card ending 4417 right now, I need the cash today."},
{"name":"get_balance","description":"Returns the current payment balance by currency, split into available, pending, and reserved funds. Use it to see how much can be paid out now and how much is still settling.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"currency":{"type":"string","description":"Filter to a single currency; omit for all"}},"required":[]},"request":"How much of our balance is available versus still pending right now?"},
{"name":"estimate_fee","description":"Calculates the processing fee for a hypothetical card payment based on amount, currency, card brand, card region, and whether the card is present. Use it for pricing questions before any payment exists.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"amount":{"type":"integer","description":"Minor units"},"currency":{"type":"string"},"card_brand":{"type":"string","enum":["visa","mastercard","amex","discover","jcb","unionpay"]},"card_region":{"type":"string","enum":["domestic","eea","international"]},"card_present":{"type":"boolean","default":false},"settlement_currency":{"type":"string","description":"If different from charge currency, includes the conversion fee"}},"required":["amount","currency"]},"request":"What would we pay in fees on a 1,200 USD payment made with an international Amex card?"},
{"name":"get_fee_summary","description":"Summarizes fees charged over a period, grouped by type (processing, chargeback, instant payout, currency conversion) and optionally by card brand or day. Use it to analyze the cost of accepting payments.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"from":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"to":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"group_by":{"type":"string","enum":["fee_type","card_brand","day","month"],"default":"fee_type"},"currency":{"type":"string"}},"required":["from","to"]},"request":"How much did we pay in chargeback fees versus processing fees in the first quarter?"},
{"name":"export_settlement_report","description":"Generates a downloadable settlement report (CSV) of all balance transactions in a date range, with gross, fee, and net per line. Use it for accounting and month-end bookkeeping.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"from":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"to":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"currency":{"type":"string"},"format":{"type":"string","enum":["csv","xlsx"],"default":"csv"},"columns":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","enum":["payment_id","type","gross","fee","net","currency","card_brand","payout_id","created_at"]}}},"required":["from","to"]},"request":"Generate the settlement report for March as a CSV for my accountant, including the payout ID on every line."},
{"name":"list_customer_payment_methods","description":"Lists the cards a customer has saved on file, showing brand, last four digits, expiry date, and whether each is the default. Use it to see which cards can be charged for that customer.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"customer_id":{"type":"string"},"email":{"type":"string","format":"email","description":"Alternative lookup if the customer ID is unknown"},"include_expired":{"type":"boolean","default":false}},"required":[]},"request":"Which cards does anna.keller@example.com have saved, and is her default one about to expire?"}
]}
